degree_rationale: Jesus the Son descending through the Four Chariots (Vessel of Light, Abode of First Man, Pillar of Glory, Call) and donning Answer/Air/Wind/Light/Water/Fire — the ten chariots. Essence of the Son's descent into the cosmos.
direction_rationale: Closes the foundational celestial-east arc with the descent of the Son through the celestial vehicles. Generative — the mounting and arming of the Savior at the start of his work.
grand_man_function: Celestial descent-vehicle — how the inmost Son enters cosmic body.
title: How Jesus the Son descends through the Four Chariots into the cosmos
